WC needs 3+ starters rotation-flagged or a 3-GW average below 55. Only 2 starters are hard-flagged (Palmer on news, Konsa at 56 min/GW), Sangaré is a soft flag only (64 min/GW passes the numeric gate), and all three are fixed by bench swaps plus 1 FT. It is not an arithmetic error. Without the transfer (Sangaré starting) the total is 96.82. Compare engines on relative xpts, not the absolute number.

claude_optimal_15.method: Maximise GW6 XI xpts from xpts.json under FPL rules (2/5/5/3, max 3 per club, 100.0m). All starters must pass the rotation gate (at least 300 of 450 mins, i.e. 60 min/GW, and no injury flag). The captain follows the locked protocol.
claude_optimal_15.notes: The XI sums to 109.34, plus 8.15 for the captain, giving 117.49. Club counts: ARS 3, EVE 3, BHA 2, HUL 2, NEW 2, BRE 1, MCI 1, SUN 1. Ødegaard (8.17) and Gabriel (9.63) are left out because of the ARS limit. Maitland-Niles (9.54) is left out by the minutes gate (177 mins).
